description:
Ask whether a cake can be delivered to an address, and what each size costs, per cake.
Use for: checking delivery and prices before sending a cake. Nothing is ordered or paid.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_cake_quote({"address":"1 Market St","city":"San Francisco","state":"CA","zip":"94105"})
Errors: quote_unavailable; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

address.description: Street and number. Send it with city, state and zip.

city.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

quantity.description: How many cakes, 1 to 100. Default 1. It can change what sizes are offered; prices stay per cake.

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long

websiteUrl.description: A company website. The bakery finds the address. Send this, or a full address.

zip.description: a string at most 20 character(s) long

name: get_cake_quote

isDeliverable.description: Left out when the address cannot get a cake.

notes.description: What the bakery says about larger orders, when it says it.

size.description: The size to name when you order.

total.description: What one cake costs you: price plus fee.

title: Get a cake quote
